root_priority: Current frozen sign-dropout pilot closes first. This is one next mechanism; no simultaneous extra scientific launch or grid. Root may qualify and execute later.
one_question: Does nonlinear other-member context transported through raw feature incidence improve actual member competence and native probability-pool quality on source-derived meanSAGE beyond generic self attribute feedback, donor-mean-first feedback and capable same-information references?
known_ancestry: TextGCN document-word two-step message passing and supervised CE
AM-GCN shared transforms across topology/feature graphs
Mean of nonlinear donor maps is ordinary set/DeepSets aggregation; nonlinear noncommutation is not a new theorem
distinct_untested_operation: One donor-nonlinear, recipient-excluded node->attribute->node feedback at source meanSAGE interlayer states, trained end to end by mean own CE and served by a fixed probability mean. No generic primitive novelty or expressivity separation asserted.

graph.native_graph_preprocessing: Reuse qualified complete provider graph with existing loops; add no loops, symmetry, topology deletions or kNN edges.
graph.attribute_incidence: B_ij=1[X_ij>0] from full permitted raw binary features; no labels/prediction errors in B. D=diag(max(row_counts,1))^-1 B; C=diag(max(column_counts,1))^-1 B^T. Zero rows/columns give zero outputs. Same B,C,D in every arm; sparse store, no materialized N-by-N feature graph.
graph.information: Full transductive X and original graph common to all arms. Deterministic incidence adds computational paths, no newly observed information or labels.

source_backbone.native_layer: Use the same dropped input for aggregate and skip: z=mean_A(Drop(h) Wagg)+Drop(h) Wskip+b; clip each row by max(L2 norm,1); first layer ReLU only; final logits also clipped.
source_backbone.input: Raw binary X, no feature normalization. Input dropout acts on stored sparse values, keeps indices including zeros. Each route own persistent IID masks; same route mask feeds its aggregate and skip.
source_backbone.optimizer: Explicit source TF1 Adam port LR .001,beta1 .9,beta2 .999,eps1e-8 before bias correction, float32 beta powers as state. All active groups updated once per complete objective; no extra feedback optimizer/schedule.
source_backbone.penalty: .05 times first-layer aggregate+skip squared effective weights; ordinary P1/PA1 use ordinary matrices. For shared arms average squared effective weights over four routes. Genuine I4 each has full own penalty. Feedback B/V unpenalized in all equipped arms, no added objective.
source_backbone.selector: Latest tied minimum total SELECT CE+native/effective L2; evaluate after each update; 50 strictly worse consecutive totals or 100000 updates. Joint banks use mean total. Genuine I4 each own selector/stop. Restore full selected model/optimizer/all RNG.
source_backbone.factorization: Each aggregate/skip W has separate learned private input r and output s; W_eff=diag(r) W diag(s). All native layer biases private per route. W shared only in S4/SA4/SM4/SX4. r/s start independent Rademacher +/-1; W Glorot uniform, bias0. Extra factor optimization changes the source learner; source P1 and F1 must remain separate competence controls.

candidate.site: After first source clipped-normalized ReLU hidden H_m, before second-layer .4 dropout; no other insertion.
equations: phi(U)=clip_row(ReLU(U Bmap) Vmap), Bmap:32 by16, Vmap:16 by32, no biases/dropout/affine norms.
Second source meanSAGE layer consumes Hprime_m with its own ordinary hidden dropout; source aggregate+skip, final logit clipping and classifiers retained.
candidate.starts: Bmap Glorot uniform, Vmap exactly zero; all equipped arms use corresponding Bmap start. Native H has norm<=1, so Vmap0 gives exactly the same forward as its unequipped factor/ordinary baseline at initialization. Bmap/donor-path gradients begin at zero until Vmap changes. This is source-function preservation at initialization only.
candidate.gradient_flow: No detaches or frozen donors. Every own CE differentiates through its Hprime into recipient layer1, into each other donor layer1 through C/phi/D, and into shared Bmap/Vmap. Shared slow W receives all recipient/donor gradient contributions. No pooled CE, KD, teacher, auxiliary diversity loss or graph reconstruction. UX4 uses live cross-body paths and a single joint objective/selector; it is a coupled four-body predictor.
candidate.bounded_feedback: C/D are nonnegative row-substochastic and phi rows norm<=1, so each added feedback row norm<=.25 before final clipping. This local norm bound is not a competence, confidence or accuracy guarantee.
candidate.serving: One complete coupled forward with deterministic dropout-off states; native pool is arithmetic mean of own softmax probabilities. Raw pool argmax is primary. No selected graph smoother/stacker/learned terminal gate.
candidate.single_equivalence: The entire SX4 bank can be written as one structured width128 node/feature-state network with grouped private maps, shared dense maps and fixed off-diagonal mixing. Four own losses are constraints, not statistical independence. PA1 tests whether one capable meanSAGE with the same self incidence feedback suffices; matching PA1 defeats a need-for-ensemble utility claim. A broadly more powerful width128 single is not exhaustively excluded by this representative panel.

controls_equivalence.common: Same full X, A, incidence definition, masks, classes, native 32-hidden normalization/dropout, optimizer equation, effective regularizer, selector patience/ceiling, export format, pool and CAL readout. Feedback arms use same site, rank16, scale.25, clip law and zero-output start.
controls_equivalence.SA4: Exactly same feedback parameters/site/incidence passes as SX4; removes peer information.
controls_equivalence.SM4: Exactly same parameters/incidence/site/number of four phi calls; averages donor hub states before phi. Tests nonlinear placement, not an ordinary single or a sharing control.
controls_equivalence.PA1: Ordinary source single plus identical rank16 self-feedback. Fewer routes and parameters are stated, not hidden as capacity equality.
controls_equivalence.IA4: Four genuinely independent equipped factor M1 models; same incidence but no donor states, cross gradients, joint optimizer or selector.
controls_equivalence.UX4: Same feedback operation and information reach, but distinct slow/factor/bias/feedback maps per donor. One joint selector matches candidate bank selection; it tests complete parameter tying, including feedback-map tying. Separate optimizers/own selectors are intentionally not used because they would change the live coupled learning/selection contract.
controls_equivalence.mismatches: Source-vs-factor controls differ in parameterization/regularization optimization; single-vs-bank and shared-vs-unshared differ in trainable count; genuine I4 uses own selectors/full own objectives. None is called equal capacity or equal compute. One-source single improvement is accepted as useful generic feedback if the shared explanation fails; it does not pass the shared candidate gate.

protocol.model_rng: joint/ordinary/factor M1 construction seed=block; genuine I4 body m=block+1000003*m, m=0..3. Private-factor stream block+281000033. Feedback Bmap stream block+281000039. Persistent native dropout RNG per route/body, never per-update reseeding. Corresponding shared-arm W/factors/Bmap and first independent body starts paired. UX4 body m matches genuine I4 body m, plus corresponding Bmap stream offset1000003*m.
protocol.roles: Custodian stratifies each fresh mask: per class20 TRAIN,30 SELECT,30 CAL; remainder DEVELOPMENT_EVAL. Totals100/150/150/34093. IDs/order common to all ten arms within a block. New role protocols are developmental on an already encountered graph, not unused task confirmation.
protocol.closure: All 48 optimizer trajectories selected/stopped and all30 bank exports/57 physical backbone states close before any CAL truth release. All30 fixed CAL endpoints close before a single complete DEVELOPMENT_EVAL release. No subset/arm/block outcome chooses a continuation. I4 independent selected states all required; joint banks restore one complete synchronized selected state. No historical TEST archive, truth, prediction arrays or model states reused.
protocol.bank_exports: CAL and DEVELOPMENT_EVAL ids, member log probabilities and pre-readout native member/pool argmax; no truth. Full selected-state receipt, all RNG/optimizer/costs. Root owns safe provider/scorer and source admission.
protocol.calibration: One scalar temperature shared across members per bank: p_T=mean_m softmax(member_log_probability_m/T); float64 CAL NLL. Optimize logT from0 by Adam LR.05,500 steps,beta.9/.999,eps1e-8,clamp logT [-5,5]; select latest tied minimum CAL NLL among step0..500, then freeze. No per-member temperatures or shared temperature across banks. Report raw and calibrated accuracy,NLL,Brier; raw accuracy is primary.

gates.scope: Exploratory three paired protocols on one graph. Complete block vectors/descriptive intervals/eight sign-flip assignments; no confirmatory p claim or node-as-independent replication. A complete useful result earns unused whole-pipeline confirmation priority.
gates.competent_backbone_precondition: Before a positive shared attribution, F1 and I4 must not reveal material factor-induced competence collapse: F1-source P1 mean accuracy>=-.25pp and no block<-.5pp; I4 mean members-source P1 mean>=-.25pp and no block<-.5pp. Failure is a factorization competence finding, not a rescue to weaker references.
gates.primary_quality: SX4 raw accuracy mean gain>=.25pp vs S4, P1, PA1, I4 and IA4; each paired block gain>0 against each. SX4-UX4 mean>=0 and no block harm>.25pp; this separate quality comparison needs no significance at3 blocks.
gates.member_competence: SX4 mean own-member raw accuracy gain>=.25pp vs S4, all3 gains>0; SX4 mean members versus IA4 mean>=-.25pp and no block harm>.5pp. Report worst/all route accuracies too.
gates.risk: SX4 calibrated DEVELOPMENT_EVAL NLL mean harm<=.02 and each block harm<=.05 against P1, PA1, I4, IA4 and UX4. Raw NLL mean harm<=.02 versus S4, SA4 and IA4. Report full raw/calibrated Brier without a post-result secondary winner.
gates.mechanism: SX4-SA4 mean raw accuracy>=.10pp, each block>=0 for peer access; SX4-SM4 mean>=.10pp, each block>=0 for donor-before-mean nonlinearity. Failure narrows attribution even if generic feedback is useful. These controls do not prove global novelty or unique optimality.
gates.retention: Exact coverage/pooling-loss/aggregation-only identity and all candidate-reference repair/harm pairs. SX4 pooling losses count must not exceed S4 or IA4 in the mean per block; otherwise reject a claim that this rule repairs the recorded pooling failure, even if accuracy is useful for another reason. No grouping weights or post hoc subgroup-primary gate.
gates.after_failure: Close exact rank16/scale.25/site/operator recipe; no rescue coefficient/rank/site grid or old endpoint reinterpretation. No automatic study/source launch. If PA1/IA4/SA4 explain gains, retain attributed generic feature feedback and record shared gate failure.

prediction_diagnostics.identity: For each node: C=any member native argmax correct; L=C and native pool wrong; G=not C and native pool correct. served_correct=sum(C)-sum(L)+sum(G). Report all counts per block and class, mean/worst members, and all pairwise gross repairs/harms.
prediction_diagnostics.predefined_fresh_regions: Fresh S4 common wrong rival Q: all four native member argmax agree on one wrong class. Record SX4 newly covered/actually served repairs on Q, including Q outside fresh IA4/I4 coverage, plus introduced common rivals and all outside harms. Define only after complete readout; use no region labels in training or graph construction.
prediction_diagnostics.scope: The old ten-mask E gap motivates competence/retention; none of those old cases or predictions enters this fresh operator or scorer. Correct-member supply and actual served repair remain different outcomes.

costs.parameter_scope: Trainable storage only, not peak/acquisition cost. Four separate feedback maps for UX4, one shared feedback map for SX4. Factor arrays counted for both matrices each layer; private biases37/route.

Root must bind finite limits and actual full-input qualification; record incomplete budgets as failures, never promote a partial panel. No timing obtained from old overlapped90-fit cohort is a speed benchmark.

falsifiers: Any materially weaker factor M1/I4 exposes a competence failure in transferring factorization to meanSAGE.
PA1 or IA4 matching/better quality shows known generic feedback/capable single or independent ensembles suffice.
SA4 matching shows peer access unnecessary.
SM4 matching shows donor-before-mean nonlinearity unnecessary.
UX4 outperforming with worthwhile gain defeats shared accuracy superiority; report real parameter tradeoff separately.
More coverage with more pooling losses or worse mean members repeats the recorded weakness/retention failure.
Positive hidden spread/local norm bound/noncommutation without predictive gain is not success.
